verdict.rationale: Datadog publishes an official API Reference at docs.datadoghq.com/api/latest, with an agent-oriented markdown version and an llms.txt docs index (confirmed HTTP 200 by probe). An official MCP server and the datadog-ci CLI add further programmatic routes for driving the product. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI spec found at the probed paths (all 404), no detail on API scope or auth beyond page titles, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product through the API.
